TRANSFER_ABOVE_POINT.why: the second definition step 7 permits; it separates the two consequences of irreflexivity that S7 lists separately, metatheoretic distinctness (irrefl_witness_ne) and the forced two-element carrier (no_witness_on_subsingleton), by asking for the first without the second; under it 'transfers' unfolds to containment in the extent of r x x -> x = y, which exceeds irreflexivity's extent by the one-point full relation alone, so the step-11 set is decided before the sweep: NONEMPTY wherever the lattice realizes an extent between the one-point full relation and that extent (in the EQ_BEARING fragment r x x -> x = y is a generator, so F3 fails there by construction), EMPTY in the pure fragment (no pure clause separates the one-point full relation from the two-point full relation: checked at N, bounded by N = 4; the general lemma is Lean target T7, not proved); the sweep confirms this at N and lists the members, it discovers neither; it is a weaker notion of soundness than the paper's, because it discounts the one-point self-difference of selfdiff_consistent
